proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly gives European Romani sov sleeps under svapati/*supati, noting the historical coalescence of those present stems. Source sections2.3.13 and3.13.3 identify present soy- beside imperative sov/sovun;3.17.3.1 identifies the infinitive suffix -ipey. These are ordinary forms of one inherited verb, not the distinct old supta past stem. Exact source morphology, stress, gloss and citation are preserved.

proposals.evidence: Turner section1 explicitly gives European Romani rov weeps. Source sections2.3.13 and3.13.3 identify Zargari ruy- beside imperative ruv/ruvun and infinitive ruyipey. The local u vowel and v/y alternation are retained; this follows the Romani rodati family, not a new assignment to section2 rudati based only on vowel resemblance. Homonymous ruv wolf is excluded. Exact source morphology, stress, gloss and citation are preserved.

These Zargari participles are based on its productive perfect stem, not automatically assigned to an ancient chinna participle node. Exact source morphology, stress, gloss and citation are preserved.

proposals.evidence: Turner gives Romani phuč-, Greek Romani puč-, Rumanian puš- and Armenian pučh- asks. The source explicitly pairs pučh-/pušl- as present/perfect stems and gives pušlom/pušlān as past1sg/2sg. Aspiration placement and the perfect affricate-to-sibilant alternation are source-supported, not reconstructed from spelling similarity. Exact source morphology, stress, gloss and citation are preserved.
